verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own APIs that cover part of the accounting workflow. The Card Expenses API retrieves approved card expenses and marks them as synced after ingestion into an ERP or accounting system, and the Bills API creates and manages vendor invoices for accounts payable. These are spend and AP APIs that feed external accounting systems rather than a dedicated accounting-data API. missing for 10: a dedicated accounting API for ledger or chart-of-accounts data, documented management of accounting fields (GL codes, tax rates, journal entries), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
